name: Uplifting
overview: Scripture calls believers to uplift one another through gracious and edifying speech, avoiding corrupt communication and promoting encouragement that ministers grace, as emphasized in Ephesians 4:29. This uplifting attitude is rooted in humility, valuing others above ourselves without strife or selfish ambition, reflecting the mindset taught in Philippians 2:3. The foundation of true upliftment is the assurance of God's steadfast presence and provision, encouraging contentment and trust as declared in Hebrews 13:5. Ultimately, the greatest act of uplifting love is demonstrated by God’s gift of His Son, offering eternal life to all who believe, as declared in John 3:16.
